title: Choose the visual world for Daan Agency
question: The roll assigned Plano Catastral. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. This build is code-led: no image generator is available here, so the cards show palette, facts and a layout sketch.

options.label: Plano Catastral
options.lineage: Colombian municipal survey and land-use plans
options.thesis: Every lead is a plot on the neighbourhood's survey sheet: numbered, zoned by tier, lettered like a plan.
options.viewport: A dark ink rail (Leads, Board, Pipeline) beside the sheet: the ranked table, each row keyed by its plot number and zoned by tier colour. A title block top-right carries area, counts and last survey date. Signature move: the score is a parcel strip, subdivided 30/30/20/20 for need, ability, momentum and reach and hatched to the amount earned; on a lead page its 500 m block is drawn as a real plot of the neighbours from their coordinates.
options.risk: Hatching and plot codes become decoration the moment they stop encoding data.

raised.raise: Every lead carries one stable plot number, shown wherever the lead appears.
Rejected and excluded leads are struck in place on the sheet, never removed.
One colour owns every live state: running jobs, selection and focus.

regions.label: ranked sheet: plot no., tier zone, parcel strip, reasons

options.label: Páginas Amarillas
options.thesis: A directory you call from: dense listings, bold heads, and reachability as the lead-in of every entry.
options.viewport: A yellow header band holds the area, search and counts; filters run down the left as a category index. The ranked list reads as directory entries in a tight column rhythm. Signature move: tier A leads are set as boxed display listings with their reasons, and each entry leads with how to reach it (phone, WhatsApp), so a missing phone reads as a visible gap.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of a lead list, and saturated yellow tires over a long session.

regions.label: directory entries: reach, name, reasons, score

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Each lead is a decision point: one band says where you are and the next move.
options.viewport: Top bar navigation over a yellow band that names the current view and the next action. Below, the ranked table with tier and score set at monumental size and reach shown as pictograms. Signature move: on a lead, the band re-signs itself after every step (approve, get insights, contact), always showing only the choices ahead.
options.case: Holds product clarity: statuses become a chain of decisions. Loses identification: an airport is nobody's neighbourhood.
options.risk: Yellow reserved for wayfinding leaves little colour for tiers and states.

regions.label: yellow sign band: where you are, next move
ranked table: monumental tier and score, reach pictograms

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles where the focused one grows and the rest recede.
options.viewport: Horizontal rails of lead tiles by tier, the focused tile expanding to show its reasons.
options.case: 216 of 235 leads have no imagery to put on a tile, and a ranked scan needs rows.
options.kept: The row in focus owns the sheet; its neighbours recede.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.thesis: Type is the interface: giant lowercase heads and flat colour tiles.
options.viewport: A panorama of tiles per tier with headlines cropped off the edge.
options.case: Giant cropped type fights a dense ranked table.
options.kept: One colour owns every live state.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: a record label's numbered catalog identity
options.thesis: Everything is a numbered catalog entry and state speaks in colour code.
options.viewport: A black index of numbered entries, each with a coded strip that decodes on hover.
options.case: State spoken in code breaks the product rule that the reason comes with the rank.
options.kept: Every item carries a stable catalog number.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: airline ticket coupons and baggage tags
options.thesis: The pipeline as a coupon book: each leg stamps itself used or void.
options.viewport: A lead as a wallet of coupons, one per stage, stamped as it moves.
options.case: Coupon legs suit a pipeline, but the main job is the ranked scan.
options.risk: Charming on one lead, slow across two hundred.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One giant letter and a slider that morphs the whole grid.
options.viewport: A specimen grid with axis sliders over the lead list.
options.case: A specimen's one giant letter has no job on a working list.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone, no ornament.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean CRM table in the manner of Linear or Attio, played straight at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A light side rail, a toolbar of filters, a white table with one accent colour and a detail panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other tools by design.
